note: Parks Canada campground on the Bow Valley Parkway (Hwy 1A), 15 km east of Lake Louise village in Banff National Park: open, gravel sites with views of Protection and Castle Mountains. Up to 2 tents and 2 cars, or 1 RV, 1 tent and 1 car, per site; all vehicles must fit on the driveway. Nearest sani-dump at Lake Louise Campground. Limited cell coverage. --Claude

POLICY ROW (federal:parks-canada) CONTRADICTION: the row says 'Fire permits are extra where sold (Banff C$12-17 a day)'. At this campground the camping page says 'Reservations include fire permits where applicable. Firewood is provided', and every one of the 72 sites in the reservation catalogue is the service type 'Unserviced with on-site Fire Pit (Fire Permit Added)'. So the C$17/day permit appears to be bundled into every booking here, not optional - which would make the booked nightly about C$43.75 (26.75 + 17). The general page wording elsewhere is 'if you would like to have a fire, permits are available for a fee at the time of reservation'. No cart quote was taken, so whether the booking engine actually adds C$17 per night is UNREAD.
